---

## Entity / ranking

Identify the person, organization, product, repository, media entity, or ranking involved.

## What appears incorrect?

- [ ] Identity / duplicate entity
- [ ] Uganda eligibility / relationship
- [ ] Raw metric
- [ ] Source mapping
- [ ] Derived metric
- [ ] Ranking input
- [ ] Historical observation
- [ ] Other

## Current value / record

Describe what TopTenUG currently shows or stores.

## Proposed correction

Describe the corrected value or relationship.

## Public supporting evidence

Provide authoritative or first-party public sources where possible.

## Effective date / period

If the correction is time-dependent, state the relevant date or quarter.

## Additional context

Explain anything needed to reproduce or verify the correction.

> Note: TopTenUG corrections should update the underlying evidence or observation first. Official ranking outputs should be recomputed rather than manually edited without provenance.
